THIS PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS  DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:16268  CRP No. 100100 of 2023 CORAM: THE HON'BLE SMT. JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI  ORAL ORDER

The present revision petition is filed aggrieved by the order dated 24.09.2021 passed in L.A.C.
No.2/2018 (LAC No.53/2017) by the Principal District Judge, Koppal, whereby the Trial Court has refused for deposit of the awarded amount.

2 . T h e f a c t s o f t h e c a s e a r e t h a t t h e p e t i t i o n e r , f o r e s t a b l i s h m e n t o f Ginigera-Gangavathi-Sindhanuru road (Karnataka Highway No.22) and its widening and improvement under (PPP) Built operate and Transfer - VGF Scheme
, wanted to acquire the lands situated in Marali Village, Gangavathi Taluk, Koppal District, and Notification was issued under Section 15 of the Karnataka Highways Act, 1964 ('KH Act', for short).
After conducting a joint survey, a final notification was issued under Section 19 of the KH Act.

A General Award was passed on 19.10.2016 and award notice was issued under Section 37(2) of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ('Act of 2013') to each land owners NC: 2024:KHC-D:16268 including the respondent herein.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ('Act of 2013'
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Since the respondent was avoiding the service of notice by the postal authorities, the petitioner having no other remedy approached the Court of District and Sessions Judge at Koppal in L.A.C. No.2/2018 (L.A.C.
No.53/2017) under Section 64(1) of the Act 0f 2013 seeking to deposit the compensation amount enabling the land owner or other interested person who have not accepted the award and to receive the compensation amount.

entities.text: Court of District and Sessions Judge at Koppal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned Trial Judge, by the order impugned, has refused the deposit of the amount as bad in law.

3. It is submitted that in an identical situation when the Court permitted the Land Acquisition Officer to deposit the award amount, the land owners filed a writ petition before this Court, and this Court passed an order with a direction to release the amount deposited by the Land Acquisition Officer in favour of the land owners, and also with a direction to the Land Acquisition Officer to pass a General Award.

This Court also observed that in the event the owners of the land had not consented for the Award passed by the Land Acquisition Officer, they can avail the remedies as available to them in NC: 2024:KHC-D:16268 law.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Trial Court has failed to exercise the jurisdiction vested in it.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the respondent submits that no notice is served on the respondent, the respondent has not participated in the enquiry and the award notice is also not served on the respondent, and the Trial Court has rightly held that the amount cannot be deposited before the Court.
5. Having heard the learned counsel on either side, perused the material on record.

6. If the Land Acquisition Officer has failed to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Act,
and land owner has not received the award notice, and if there is violation of any nature, it is always open to the land owner agitate the same before an appropriate forum.
The Court below, at the threshold, ought not to have rejected the application for deposit of the amount.
Even after the amount is deposited, no prejudice would be caused to the respondent as the respondent is always at liberty to agitate his claim before the appropriate forum.

In that view of the matter, the order NC:
2024:KHC-D:16268 impugned is liable to be set aside and the Land Acquisition Officer shall be permitted to deposit the amount before the Trial Court.

Hence, this Court is passing the following:
ORDER i) The Trial Court is directed to permit the Land Acquisition Officer to deposit the award amount.
ii) On deposit of the award amount, if the respondent-land owner wants to withdraw the amount, he is at liberty to withdraw the same if it is permissible in law.
iii) Accordingly, this petition is disposed off.
iv) All pending I.As. in this petition shall stand closed.

Sd/-
JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI KMS CT:BCK LIST NO.: 1 SL NO.: 31.1
